subject: CONTRACT L2 TGP2 extended buffer table (set0 buffer bindings 8..30): exact header diff request + bridge recipe; 87/87 real corpus kernels compile
body:
Compiler: mali_compute_compiler.c 419f8227 (committed, gated #ifdef TEGU_PIPELINE2_TABLE_BUFFER => inactive with current header ff2889fc; shared lib stays 1877804b). Proposed header (compute-owned) gpu/build/lowering-claude-20261025/proposed-header-buftable/pipeline_format.h sha ce462be8 = ff2889fc plus ONLY:
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_MAX_BUFFERS 31u (was 8; check frontend arrays sized by it)
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_FAU_BUFFERS 8u
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_TABLE_BUFFER 3u
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_FLAG_BUFFER_TABLE 8u (header w16)
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_BUFFER_TABLE_FAU 272u
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_BUFFER_TABLE_RECORD 16u
 #define TEGU_PIPELINE2_WORD_BUFFER_MASK 19u (w19 = mask of bindings 8..30)
 tegu_pipeline_info2: 'reserved' -> 'buffer_table_mask' (same size/offset; rename any frontend use of .reserved).
 parse2: w16 may contain FLAG_BUFFER_TABLE; w19&~0x7fffff00 must be 0; UBO/SSBO records: entry==binding<31, table==FAU for binding<8 else TABLE_BUFFER; ext mask==w19 and flag set iff mask!=0; info.buffer_table_mask=w19.
Semantics: bindings 0..7 unchanged (FAU records at 16*b, w8). For b in 8..30 the shader loads record b (16 bytes {u64 address, u32 bytes, u32 0}, same as FAU records) from memory: base/size come from the FAU record at byte 272 ({u64 table_va, u32 table_bytes, u32 0}); the record read is bounds-checked against table_bytes (outside => zero record => zero-length buffer), then all accesses are 64bit_bounded_global as for FAU buffers. push_words in the header already covers 272..287 (max 71 seen).
BRIDGE (compute): for a packet with FLAG_BUFFER_TABLE, per dispatch allocate an owned BO >= 16*(highest table binding+1) bytes (or 496), write record b = {va(resource b)+offset_b, length_b, 0} for every binding in w19 (resolved/retained exactly like FAU buffers; unbound => refuse as today), zero others; write {bo_va, bo_bytes, 0} at FAU 272; retain BO and every referenced resource BO to job completion; include resources in the write mask as today. TDG2 wire must carry up to 31 buffer descriptors (currently 8) — your wire limit.
Evidence (host only): private lib 614e9b56 (lib-buftable, built with ce462be8): 87/87 unique corpus kernels formerly 'TGP2 buffers require set0 single descriptors0..7' compile (bindings up to 30, max push 71 words), manifest/header 0 inconsistencies (gpu/build/lowering-claude-20261025/l2-buftable/replay-buftable.json); compute-v2 113/113 incl. legacy exact. Please land header, post 'TGP2 buffer-table header <sha>' and I rebuild the shared lib under L2. Remaining refusals unchanged: descriptor arrays (2 unique, storage-image arrays need entry!=binding table allocation — separate proposal), no-code kernels (4), physical pointers (L1).
